messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Error in t(A1.inv) : object 'A1.inv' not found
parts:
On 02/21/2018 11:14 PM, David Kaplan wrote:
> As with Muhummad's post on 2/16, I am also experiencing this error message,
>
> Error in t(A1.inv) : object 'A1.inv' not found

This was indeed a (temporary) bug in dev 0.6-1 (only!). Now fixed in
0.6-1.1189.

This does work correctly with the CRAN version (0.5-23.1097)! You can
use sessionInfo() to check the loaded versions.

Note that in 0.6-1, the value printed for the yuan-bentler test
statistic will be different from the 'old' (0.5) value. To get back the
old value, use mimic = "Mplus".

Yves.
